title: Treasury spend
body: Gov.Treasury-Spend pays up to what the treasury holds, and with reserve funding at most 10 % of the treasury per 30-day window (checked when it applies). Never to the DAO, the beacon or the token. Quantity is in atoms (10^6 per RNG). It moves money or code, so it carries Effective-At (filled by dao-propose: the vote's end + 24 h + 1 day of margin); it takes effect only then, when anyone sends Gov.Apply, and until then validators may leave by the exit hatch (Exit-Now) and the DAO may cancel it (Gov.Cancel).
